# cvp_change_control (Resource)

ChangeControl — bundle of rendered device configs + schedule + approval + start.
See docs/integration-drafts/um-docs/07-architecture/cvp/06-workspace-changecontrol.md.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cvp_change_control" "deploy" {
  workspace_id        = cvp_workspace.bgp_as_bump.id
  description         = "Deploy leaf BGP AS bump"
  auto_approve        = false # human approves via UI or a separate CI step
  wait_for_execution  = true
  stage_execution     = "rolling"
  stop_on_failure     = true
  rollback_on_failure = true

  depends_on = [cvp_studio_inputs.rack3_bgp]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String)

### Optional

- `auto_approve` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `rollback_on_failure` (Boolean)
- `schedule_at` (String)
- `stage_execution` (String)
- `stop_on_failure` (Boolean)
- `wait_for_execution` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `execution_error` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A cvp_change_control is imported by its change-control id.
terraform import cvp_change_control.deploy cc-8f3c0b2a1d4e4a9b
```
